scope: Release-note features beyond property-name delta coverage. Complements routeros-7.25-api.json; not a catalog of all historical RouterOS functionality.

features.validation: TestRouterOS725WifiProfileFeatures; TestRouterOS725WifiReferenceVariants; TestAccWifi7251Distance (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: Decimal kilometers, 0..4294967.295, truncated to three decimal places. Named driver variants preserved. Physical radio behavior unverified.

features.validation: TestAppYAML; TestAppLifecycle; TestAccApp7251; TestAccApp7251Deployment (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: Container package/device mode and configured App storage/networking required. YAML retains service privileged and networkRouterIP placeholders.

features.validation: TestAppActionLifecycle; TestAppActionPlanning; TestAccApp7251Deployment (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: Operations are explicit, asynchronous, and irreversible where applicable. Refresh/delete never execute an action.

features.validation: Inspected official 7.25 CLI reference and live x86 IoT package 7.25.1: root set, advertisers set, scanners set and peripheral-devices set have no power argument.
features.limits: Requires Bluetooth-capable hardware to establish argument name, range, capability conditions and readback. No guessed attribute is exposed.

features.validation: TestWifi7ExistingSchemaCompatibility; TestWifi7UpgradeNoOpPlans; TestAccWifi7ProfilesAndMLD (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: API/REST logical creation, in-place rename, import, and monitoring verified on CHR. Physical affiliation/traffic needs compatible radios.

features.validation: TestWifi7ExistingSchemaCompatibility; TestWifi7UpgradeNoOpPlans; TestWifi7ExplicitFalseAndStringsWritten; TestAccWifi7ProfilesAndMLD (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: API/REST profile configuration and explicit resets verified. Actual puncturing/AFC requires hardware, drivers, and regulatory support.

features.validation: TestWifi7ExistingSchemaCompatibility; TestWifi7UpgradeNoOpPlans; TestAccWifi7ProfilesAndMLD; TestAccWifi7CAP (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: API/REST configuration, resets, and imports verified; over-the-air CAP MLO provisioning is hardware-dependent.

features.validation: TestWifi7ExistingSchemaCompatibility; TestWifi7UpgradeNoOpPlans; TestAccWifi7ProfilesAndMLD (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: API/REST profiles and WPA2-PSK-SHA2 accepted; physical authentication and beacon integrity require hardware tests.

features.validation: TestWifi7PinnedWriteContracts; TestAccWifi7ProfilesAndMLD (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: Complete documented writable template API exposed, with labels as selectors and .id import; hardware application is unverified.

features.validation: TestWifi7OperationalState; TestAccWifi7ProfilesAndMLD (logical MLD monitoring and empty radio inventory on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: Read-only capability inventory and forced-once monitoring; MLD link and AFC status are driver-dependent.

features.validation: TestWifi7PinnedWriteContracts; TestWifi7RadioSettingsUnsupported; live CHR 7.25.1 rejects writes as Not supported
features.limits: Documented and live-inspected schema; CHR rejects setting these properties as Not supported. Hardware validation required.

features.validation: TestWifi7ExistingSchemaCompatibility; TestWifi7UpgradeNoOpPlans; TestAccWifi7ProfilesAndMLD (API and REST on CHR 7.25.1)
features.limits: Driver-specific installation choices and client limits; physical station roaming requires hardware tests.
